provenance.kind: Visual annotations of the supplied edited recordings; not measured controller telemetry or live action recognition.
provenance.review: Reviewed full recordings with overview frames (cup every 2 seconds, short clips every 0.5 seconds), then 0.25-second samples around navigation/manipulation transitions and 0.5-second samples around cup disposal. Labels group visible task phases, including preparation and holding. Re-reviewed hand-motion onsets after user feedback: bag at 0.125-second spacing from4–6.5s and approximately one-frame spacing5.2–5.5s; cup reach6.5–10.5s and release31–35s at0.25-second spacing; cloth1–2.875s at0.125-second spacing, with the full clip reviewed for tabletop contact.
provenance.boundaryPrecision: Approximate visual transitions, stored at encoded frame boundaries; uncertainty about 0.25 seconds. Arm preparation can overlap base navigation.
provenance.playback: Original full edits at user-requested browser rates: Bag retrieval2×, Cup disposal3×, Table wiping2×. Rates multiply each edit’s existing encoded speed. Phase boundaries remain in source-video time.
provenance.boundaryRule: Navigation includes approach, settling and pre-action holding. Switch to manipulation at visible task-directed hand motion, not arrival proximity or a transport arm posture. Bag pickup starts at frame159 (5.3053s); cup reach frame270 (9.009s); cup release frame1049 (35.0016s); wiping frame159 (5.3053s).

tasks.label: Bag retrieval
tasks.command: Pick up the bag and bring it to the table.

steps.title: Approach the bag
steps.body: The base approaches and settles in front of the bag before the hands begin the pickup.

steps.title: Grasp and lift the bag
steps.body: The hands reach for the handles, close, and lift the bag from the seat.

steps.title: Carry the bag to the table
steps.body: The base turns and transports the bag. The edit ends during the approach; no set-down is shown.

tasks.label: Cup disposal
tasks.command: Put the white cup into the trash.

steps.title: Approach the cup
steps.body: The base approaches and settles at the table before the hands reach for the cup.

steps.title: Pick up the cup
steps.body: The robot reaches, grasps the cup, and holds it above the table.

steps.title: Carry the cup to the trash
steps.body: The base carries the cup to the bin and settles before the release motion.

steps.title: Release the cup
steps.body: The robot positions the cup over the bin, releases it, and withdraws its hands.

steps.title: Move away from the bin
steps.body: The base turns and travels away after disposal.

tasks.label: Table wiping
tasks.command: Wipe the table with the cloth.

steps.title: Approach the table
steps.body: The base approaches the table while carrying the cloth; manipulation begins with the tabletop motion.

steps.title: Wipe the table
steps.body: The hand moves the cloth across the tabletop.
